ideas.pitch: An interactive transpiler that rewrites standard C++ or Python code into hyper-minified golfed versions using AST transformations and alternative primitive loops.
ideas.title: CodeGolfOptimizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets the exact Code Golfing category of the event with a high-utility developer tool, mirroring the hard engineering seen in winning compiler and code transformation projects.

ideas.pitch: A specialized interactive debugger visualizer that traces complex memory bounds errors, segmentation faults, and off-by-one errors in competitive programming snippets.
ideas.title: DebugLens
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly tackles the Debugging round format by giving users a tangible tool that solves a pain point every competitive programmer faces under time pressure.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight local runner and benchmarking sandbox that profiles time and memory complexity of competitive programming solutions against edge-case test generators.
ideas.title: CPBenchAnalyzer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses heavily on precise algorithmic execution and performance metrics, appealing directly to competitive programming judges who value speed and correctness.

ideas.pitch: A custom esoteric scripting layer designed specifically for ultra-short token counts to solve competitive programming string and array manipulation challenges.
ideas.title: GolfScriptEngine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages genuine engineering creativity in language design to win over judges looking for unique approaches to code golfing constraints.

ideas.pitch: An automated regression and fault-localization utility that compares passing and failing test outputs to pinpoint logical branches responsible for runtime exceptions.
ideas.title: FaultTrace
ideas.why_it_could_win: Delivers an exceptionally polished solution for the debugging track with an interactive live demo that works out of the box.
